craft_notes: Sthāyin: cast-down (gaze turns the mind unburdened). Rows: row 3 (unsupported→Śiva may go). Close: to (pada-svārtha: going-to — destination withheld as verb: Śiva one may go TO — the direction is the name). Rejected: 'attains liberation' — killed: may go kept (vraj — motion, arrival open); 'drops awareness' — killed: gaze cast down kept (the act, not the effect).

lines: Gross-formed state's fixed gaze cast down quickly:
unsupported mind made — Śiva one may go to.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sthūlarūpasya bhāvasya stabdhāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nipātya ca | acireṇa nirādhāraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā śivaṃ vrajet

reads_against.argmap: What happens to fixed gaze on gross-form? → Casting the fixed gaze down, the unsupported mind goes to Śiva.
c1_essence: Fixed gaze cast down: unsupported mind, Śiva.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness at the edge of intensity)
